sources.marks: No face, no maker's logo: the phone is side-on with its front facing camera, only tiny red dots on the side buttons, which you can desaturate if needed. Past about 10 s the right hand moves in and covers the frame, so end the stretch by 9.5 s.

sources.marks: The face is visible in the full frame but fully excluded by the given crop. Never widen it, and do not move it up or right, or the hair and face come in at the top right. A black wristwatch sits at the right edge, mostly cut off; no legible brand. The phone back is black, with no visible logo at this size.
